 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Tony Xu, co-founder, and CEO of DoorDash. And today it's one of the largest food delivery and logistics platforms globally. In our conversation, we discussed the initial problem that DoorDash set out to solve, DoorDash's counter-intuitive approach to building their product and the surprising benefits of capital constraints indoor DoorDash's early days.
